decision_conditions: The  advertisement by reason of its size, scale, siting, inappropriate materials/design would appear visually prominent, leading to an obtrusive feature that would have a  harmful impact on the visual amenities of the street scene as well as impacting the non-designated heritage asset Locally Listed host building. It would therefore lead to a degrading of the visual quality of the building whilst failing to enhance or preserve the character, appearance and significance of the surrounding Ickenham Village Conservation Area or the setting of the adjoining Grade II Listed Building resulting in less than substantial harm to these heritage assets that would not be outweighed by the public benefits of the proposal, contrary to Policies DMHB 1, DMHB 4; DHHB 11, DMHB 12 and DMHB 13A of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 Development Management Policies (2020);  Policies D1, D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021) and the relevant provisions of the NPPF 2024, in particular paragraphs 139, 141, 208.
